+title: Add DotfolderStack.Source.marketplace in Extras and fix the ACPAgent switch
+---
+## What
+
+marketplace.md §4.3 and decision 8. A marketplace layer needs its own source tag, so provenance is correct and the layer never renders trusted. This is a change in two sibling repositories. Do the steps in this order, because `FoundationModelsACPAgent` tracks Extras `main`.
+
+1. **Extras** — `/Users/wballard/github/swissarmyhammer/FoundationModelsExtras/Sources/FoundationModelsExtras/DotfolderStack.swift`: add `case marketplace` to `public enum Source` (after `project`). Doc comment: a cached remote skill marketplace layer; never trusted. `DotfolderStack.init` must never derive this case; only a host adds such a layer. Search Extras `Sources/` for exhaustive `switch` on `Source` and update each one. Commit and push Extras `main`.
+2. **ACPAgent** — `/Users/wballard/github/swissarmyhammer/FoundationModelsACPAgent`: run `swift package update FoundationModelsExtras`. In `Sources/FoundationModelsACPAgent/Configuration/ConfigurationLayerName.swift:29` (`init(_ source: DotfolderStack.Source?)`), add `case .marketplace?`. Add a `marketplace` case to `ConfigurationLayerName`, and fix every switch that the compiler then reports. Commit `Package.resolved` and the change. Push.
+3. **This package** — run `swift package update FoundationModelsExtras`. `StencilPass.resolvedTrust` (`Sources/FoundationModelsSkills/Render/StencilPass.swift:248`) needs no change: every source except `.defaults` is untrusted. Add a test that proves this for `.marketplace`.
+
+- [ ] Extras: add `Source.marketplace`, update the switches, run tests, push
+- [ ] ACPAgent: update the Extras pin, map `.marketplace?` in `ConfigurationLayerName`, run tests, push
+- [ ] This package: update the Extras pin in `Package.resolved`
+- [ ] This package: add the `.marketplace` trust test
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] `DotfolderStack.Source.marketplace` exists on Extras `main`
+- [ ] `swift build` and `swift test` pass in Extras, in ACPAgent, and in this package with zero warnings
+- [ ] A `.marketplace` layer renders through `TemplateEngine.Trust.untrusted` in `StencilPass`
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] Extras: add a case to the existing `DotfolderStack` tests that a default `DotfolderStack(name:workingDirectory:)` never produces a `.marketplace` layer
+- [ ] ACPAgent: add a test in its configuration tests that `ConfigurationLayerName(.marketplace)` gives `.marketplace`
+- [ ] This package: add a test to `Tests/FoundationModelsSkillsTests/StencilPassTests.swift`: a body with `{% now %}` in a `.marketplace` layer draws the untrusted-rejection error, and the same body in a `.defaults` layer renders
+- [ ] Run `swift test` in each of the three repositories; all green
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass. #marketplace
\ No newline at end of file
